notes: Seven-host H4 FX cointegration universe from approved card QM5_10025. Each setfile runs on one registered .DWX host; monthly selection chooses one foreign partner from the other six symbols. The host leg opens through QM_TM_OpenPosition at its registered slot, the foreign partner opens through QM_BasketOpenPosition, and the package risk is beta-weighted across both legs.

This is a multi-symbol dependency manifest, not a synthetic logical-basket manifest: Q02 must retain one real host work item per registered setfile. The absence of logical_symbol/host_symbol/host_timeframe is intentional and keeps farm fanout on the seven canonical .DWX hosts.
